title: ‘Ebola takes the people children depend on’: UNICEF
content:

title: Kenya races to trace all contacts after first Ebola death, WHO official says
content:
Kenya’s first Ebola death has triggered a race to trace everyone the victim came into contact with, as the United Nations and partners provide full support, the World Health Organization’s (WHO) top official in the country has told UN News in her first interview on the case.  Read Full Story on UN News

title: From drought to deluge: ‘Super’ El Niño’s expanding reach
content:
Across Papua New Guinea, water sources are drying up, crops are failing and food prices are rising months before the worst agricultural impacts are expected. Behind those warning signs is an El Niño whose Pacific Ocean temperatures have already surpassed the equivalent measurements during the historic 1997 and 2015 events – part of an unfolding [...]
